title: Accept an invitation
caption: PF-20 AC3. Do it in a second browser (or a private window) as the invited person.

steps.title: Open the link
steps.expect: Clean URL `/invitations/accept`, "Join <OTA>" with inviter, role, address and expiry.

steps.title: No account yet
steps.body: **Create an account** (address prefilled), verify through Mailpit, sign in, open the link again.
steps.expect: After verification the browser lands on `/sign-in?verified=1` (sign-up and `/verify-email` drop `next`): sign in, then open the invitation link from the e-mail again (the invitation cookie lasts 15 minutes, the link 7 days).

steps.title: Wrong account
steps.body: Open the link while signed in with another address.
steps.expect: "This invitation is for another address" and "Sign out and sign in with the invited address"; no Accept button.

steps.title: Accept
steps.expect: Redirect to `/otas/<tenantId>`; `tenant_memberships` row active with the invited role; invitation `accepted`, `accepted_account_id` set.
